scripts.dev: npm run build -w @doomsday/shared && concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w @doomsday/api" "npm run dev -w @doomsday/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @doomsday/shared && npm run build -w @doomsday/api && npm run build -w @doomsday/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @doomsday/shared && npm run typecheck -w @doomsday/api && npm run typecheck -w @doomsday/web
